hooks.command:
r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"
[ -n "$r" ] || { echo "bee: hook transport unavailable (no git root)" >&2; exit 0; }
for b in "$r"/.bee/bin/bee "$r"/.bee/bin/bee.exe; do [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" hook session-init --source=repo; done
g="$(git -C "$r" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$g" ] && for b in "$g/../.bee/bin/bee" "$g/../.bee/bin/bee.exe"; do [ -x "$b" ] && exec "$b" hook session-init --source=repo; done
echo "bee: hook binary missing (.bee/bin/bee)" >&2; exit 0
hooks.commandWindows: git -c alias.beehook="!git rev-parse --show-toplevel >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'bee: hook transport unavailable (no git root)' >&2; exit 0; }; [ -x .bee/bin/bee ] && exec .bee/bin/bee hook session-init --source=repo; [ -x .bee/bin/bee.exe ] && exec .bee/bin/bee.exe hook session-init --source=repo; echo 'bee: hook binary missing (.bee/bin/bee)' >&2; exit 0" beehook
